scope_note: Covers the vitamin content requirements for margarine sold by retail in each UK jurisdiction, and the current in-force position in each. Limited to legislation; enforcement practice and EU marketing standards beyond their domestic implementation are out of scope.

steps.title: Retrieve the vitamin content provision for each UK jurisdiction
steps.detail: Find the regulation imposing minimum and maximum vitamin A and vitamin D levels in margarine for England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, and retrieve its text.

steps.title: Establish the in-force status of each
steps.detail: Check whether each jurisdiction's vitamin content provision remains in force, identifying any instrument that amended or omitted it and what exactly that instrument did.

steps.title: State the position jurisdiction by jurisdiction
steps.detail: Set out where the requirement still applies and where it has been removed, rather than answering for one jurisdiction as if it were the United Kingdom.
